title: Avatar customization sections
description: Where every avatar choice appears: per part (layer), the ordered sections with their pt-BR names and the members that put each texture in exactly one section. Consumers: avatars/native_export.py (local customizer list, accessories.json), avatars/sections.py (admin-api/woka.json and admin-api/companions.json). Rules a schema cannot express are enforced by avatars/sections.py and tests/test_avatar_sections.py: every texture of a list matches exactly one member of its part; every member matches at least one texture; names and ids are unique within a part and never reserved; an empty section resolves to one fully transparent texture; the first section of each part exists in every list (it is the engine's default and the only pool its Randomizar draws from); accessory sections follow the catalog draw order, and sections sharing a group hold one piece at a time.

reservedNames.description: Section names added at runtime by other code (theme/avatars/bridge.js adds the visitor's own Koncluí avatar to the ready-made characters). The customizer keys sections by name, so no section may use them.

legacyPieces.description: Koncluí pieces drawn before the v3 catalog (art/build_woka.py). They are in production and in the local customizer; this list is their only definition of part, name and URLs.

member.description: A texture id, a glob over texture ids ('*' only, e.g. kc-hair-short-*) or a catalog collection (option.collection in avatars/catalog.json). Order is display order; a glob or collection keeps source order (engine list, then catalog, then legacyPieces).

id.description: Stable machine id, unique within the part.

name.description: What players read (pt-BR), unique within the part.

empty.description: The 'nothing' choice of an optional part.

group.description: Exclusivity group of local-wa/accessories.js: one piece per group. Required unless the section is empty.

customizerPart.description: A tab of the native customizer; label and heading replace the engine's English tab text and '<part> Options' heading.
